title: Single-Cycle Battery Remaining Useful Life Prediction with Compressed Continuous Wavelet Features and Deep Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.34159v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Lithium-ion batteries are widely used in industrial applications, but their performance gradually degrades over time, making accurate lifetime prediction important for safety and reliability. However, reliable lifetime assessment generally requires extensive degradation testing, which is both costly and time-consuming. To reduce this burden, recent data-driven approaches have sought to predict the end-of-life cycle of batteries from only the initial few cycles. Nevertheless, identifying reliable degradation patterns from such limited early-cycle data remains challenging because early aging dynamics are often subtle and nonlinear. To address this issue, we adopt the continuous wavelet transform to convert cycle-wise voltage, current, and capacity signals into time-frequency representations, enabling multi-resolution characterization of degradation behavior. Building on this representation, we apply scale compression to reduce redundancy

translated_title: 基于压缩连续小波特征与深度神经网络的电池单循环剩余使用寿命预测
translated_abstract: 锂离子电池广泛应用于工业领域，但其性能会随时间逐渐退化，因此准确的寿命预测对安全性和可靠性至关重要。然而，可靠的寿命评估通常需要进行大量的退化测试，这既昂贵又耗时。为减轻这一负担，近期的数据驱动方法试图仅利用电池最初的几个循环来预测其寿命终点。尽管如此，从如此有限的早期循环数据中识别可靠的退化模式仍然具有挑战性，因为早期的老化动态往往十分微妙且呈非线性。为解决这一问题，我们采用连续小波变换将逐循环的电压、电流和容量信号转换为时频表示，从而实现对退化行为的多分辨率表征。基于该表示，我们进一步应用尺度压缩来减少冗余（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出利用连续小波变换将电池循环的电压、电流和容量信号转换为时频表示，经尺度压缩消除冗余后输入深度神经网络，仅凭单个循环的数据即可实现对电池剩余使用寿命的准确预测。
